{{Quote|Phew, I thought they were secured, but one slip, and they're scattered everywhere!}}
Fratellino is the youngest of the [[The Three Fratellis' Challenge|Fratelli Brothers]] and is training to join the Pioneer Association with his brothers, but he is very clumsy to his brothers and Rover's dismay. He asks Rover for help in '''Echo Challenge: Unfinished Book'''.

Each challenge rewards Union EXP x30, [[Astrite]] x20, [[Monnaie]] x40, and EXP Materials. Completing all his challenge will grant the quest [[The Bizarre Brothers: Fratellino]].
